opponent.label: Momo
opponent.description: Momo Yaoyorozu, the Everything Hero: Creati. A professional hero and graduate of UA High School, home of Japan's premiere hero course. A natural leader, Momo is cool and collected in the face of danger, and kind and polite among peers. Her Quirk allows her to create any non-living material/object from her exposed skin by transforming the molecular structure of the lipids in her body.
